evals.prompt: 현재 변경사항을 의미별로 나눠서 스테이징하고, 각 묶음마다 커밋 메시지 후보 3개를 보여준 뒤 선택하면 커밋하고 다음 묶음으로 넘어가줘.
evals.expected_output: A staged-scope workflow that proposes atomic groups before staging, stages only one group at a time, generates 3 candidates from staged changes, commits after selection, then repeats for remaining groups.
assertions: Output proposes commit groups before staging
Output generates candidates from only the current staged group
Output repeats status/staging after each successful commit
Output leaves protected local files unstaged unless explicitly requested

evals.prompt: 이미 일부 파일만 staged야. 이 staged 변경만 기준으로 커밋 메시지 후보 3개를 만들고 선택하면 커밋해줘. unstaged는 건드리지 마.
evals.expected_output: A candidate flow for the already staged scope that does not alter unstaged files and commits only after the user selects one of three candidates.
assertions: Output does not change staging when user asks for staged-only candidates
Output presents exactly 3 candidates plus Reroll
Output commits only after explicit selection
